content: I4 found SPY overnight gap predicts VaR violations (4.7x lift). Tested if this effect is universal across 7 assets. Hypothesis: gap effect is mechanical (info accumulates while market closed) so should exist wherever there's a closing period. BTC-USD is the natural control (24/7 trading, no structural gap). Also tested SPY gap contagion to other assets.
